name: Machine Single-Arm High Row
steps: Sit facing the chest pad and take one high handle, steadying yourself with your free hand on the machine.
Set your chest against the pad and reach the working arm forward and up.
Pull the handle down and back toward your ribs by driving your elbow behind you and squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Return the handle slowly to full extension, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your torso pressed steadily into the pad without twisting toward the pulling side.
Keep your shoulder away from your ear throughout the pull.
